newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: New Mauritius Hotels pre-tax profit up 44 percent.
newsitem.headline: New Mauritius Hotels pre-tax profit up 44 percent.

text.p: Hotel group New Mauritius Hotels reported on Wednesday a 44.2 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 231.1 million rupees ($11.5 million) for the financial year ending 30 September 1996 from 160.3 million rupees in the previous year.

After tax profit for 1995/96 was posted at 264.2 million rupees, up 64.6 percent from 160.5 million rupees in 1994/95. New Mauritius Hotels turnover rose by 24.8 percent to 1.02 billion rupees in 1995/96 from 821.0 million rupees in 1994/95.
New Mauritius Hotels is one of the leading hotel groups in this tropical Indian Ocean island and holds a stake in six hotels establishments with a total room capacity of 1,189.
